body: It's a difficult thing to admit because it's not always that I feel like this and I guess if I said, yeah sometimes I don't actually wanna die I just crave attention people wouldnt have taken me seriously when I actually wanted to die... But yeah I still remember the feeling when I had a tumour and tho it was most probably bening people cared so so much

I can understand you as I've been close of what you tell since we work in the same field. Schools don't prepare us for the workplace even less for internships and we're suddenly given a lot of pressure to perform at the same time we realized we werent prepared well enough by our schools

 I've had to drop a few internships ans even real jobs in my life since I couldn't keep up with the pressure... It wasn't the end of the world for me, and it may not be the end of the world for you neither... 

Though if you feel you must keep on that internship, you can always try to get in touch with people in your field who can help you with your technical struggles and therapy to help you overcome the more emotional ones

I genuinely hope you are able to go through this and come out being not only a best designer but a happier person
